description: Støysoner for Bane NORs jernbanenett is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bane NOR SF. Datasettet inneheld støysonekart for Bane NORs jernbanenett utarbeidd i samsvar med "Retningslinje for behandling av støy i arealplanlegging (T-1442)". Støysonekarta viser berekna raud (Lden68 dB) og gul (Lden58dB) støysone. Coverage: Bane NOR SF. The publisher named on the listing is Bane NOR SF. Its keywords include modellbaserteVegprosjekter, støysoner, National, fellesDatakatalog, jernbane, t-1442. The listing shows 5 download or service links in TXT, SQL, XML, GDB. The listing shows 2025-03-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
